name: Wizard OS 0.3.74 — 0.3.73 with current App Manager main (quick interface updates, automatic app updates, Store data repaired)
about: Stable 0.3.73 with the App Manager moved from its maintenance line (08b54f65) to current main (79272034). The reason for the cut: interface-only releases now install in about 2 minutes instead of the 10–20 minute installer rerun (wizard-app-manager #304); boxes take that quick path for the release after this one. App Manager main also carries every fix merged there since 0.3.67's line, including: an installer rerun that no longer fails at `wizard link` while the App Manager rewrites app skills (#311), the App Store data service starting again on alongside boxes (#312), the app-change rule keeping the owner approval gate and checking every changed file (#320), safe Wizard changes and owner-approved problem reports in the guide (#316), nightly automatic app updates, verified and rolled back on failure (#305, #307), update backups that no longer pile up (#303), backups that finish on a busy agent and cover digest-pinned apps (#273, #292), apps can no longer act as the owner through the owner listener (#293), trusted exposure and truthful network identity (#278), default-app custody (#280, #284), fixed-name volumes surviving an App Manager upgrade (#290), the shared Hermes update lock (#212), the Hermes restart waiting for the live chat turn (#243), and the full agent sheet (#302). Features riding along from App Manager main: app connections, where each connection between apps is its own Docker network (#271, #283, #288), the Connections map and controls from the phone (#294, #297, #298, #300, #310), an hourly public phone-app mirror timer independent of box updates (#214), one-way alerts sent to Notifications instead of new chats (#184), the builder's app-style contract and app-changes-ship-in-the-app rule (#317, #318), Store installs from share links (#232), apps starting on the shared design rules (#270), and the Claude account broker on alongside boxes (#249). #274 adds a web-search default slot on main, but this release's default_apps are exactly 0.3.73's, so pinned installs do not add Search. Wizard UX, Agent Service, Notifications, Troubleshooter, Hermes and every other image and default app are exactly 0.3.73's.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.
